Geraldine

Biography

Geraldine leads the settlement near the mines. The empty caravan and accusations against the newcomers put her judgment to the test, while Trickster helps explain their position. Her relationship with Karansul later supplies an alibi in the search for Brissen’s murderer. [1, 2, 3]
